bugs_found: transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal; float or non-Decimal amounts can raise TypeError after partial assumptions and bypass consistent validation semantics
transfer does not reject NaN/Infinity explicitly; Decimal NaN/Infinity or float NaN can produce unexpected exceptions or invalid balances
transfer is non-atomic: if crediting account_to.balance fails after debiting account_from.balance, funds are lost
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months via int(months), changing repayment terms without error
compound_interest silently truncates years and compounds_per_year via int(...), producing undeclared behavior for fractional inputs
compound_interest does not validate principal >= 0, allowing negative principal outputs
apply_fee allows fee_pct > 1 and fee_min/fee_max greater than amount, returning negative net amounts
fx_convert does not validate rate > 0 or finite, so zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates can produce invalid conversions
